title: SEC3: content_type slash rule inconsistent across paths
description: kith-chat validate_content_type checks \!ct.contains('/') — at least one slash present. kith-peer checks slash_count \!= 1 — exactly one slash. A content_type like 'image/png/extra' passes kith-chat but fails kith-peer. The exactly-one-slash rule is the correct rule for a MIME type (RFC 2045 type/subtype). Both codepaths should use the same rule. This is a consistency gap, not an active security issue (content_type is stored, not used in filesystem paths), but it means locally-authored messages can store values that peer delivery would reject.
